summary: dockInReach (step.ts) now moors a ship whose hull overlaps the berth tile or any of its eight neighbours, where a diagonal neighbour counts only if one of the two tiles it shares with the berth is navigable. Otherwise it falls back to reach plus a clear run. dockRadius stays 384. Per the operator addendum from design challenge attempt 5, 'beside' is decided from every tile the hull square overlaps, in both dockInReach and the test oracle. Removed the land spur at (20-21, 28) from the sketch; the map is mirrored, so this removes all four copies. Regenerated slice-sea.tmj and sliceSea.ts with `npm run map:build -- --from-sketch`, and every validator passes. The sketch writer moved into scripts/build-map.ts behind --from-sketch; sketch.ts is deleted and sliceSeaSketch.ts has no Node import. maps.test.ts now reads the sketch through ?raw and fails on any node: specifier. Fixed the stale sketch.ts references in the test title, the header comments, README.md, assets/source/maps/README.md and docs/architecture.md. The docking paragraph in architecture.md now uses the addendum's sentence and is 722 characters, one shorter than before. Tests in simulation.test.ts: the diagonal half of the old corner test now moors, and its shoal-segment hullPathIsClear assertions are kept. New tests: the pinch guard with land and with shoal; behind land with dockRadius 640; the head-on approach (heading 48, offsets -336 and -368) on the synthetic island and on the real dock (23, 27); and the addendum's column-25 case at (23, 27) for x from 6400 to 6479. The old sweep is replaced by a start-grid sweep: 64-sub-unit sea starts at Chebyshev distance 2-4 from the berth, every 8th heading into an open side, speeds 0, half and full. It covers the synthetic island and all 8 real docks, 97,326 lanes. Every step is checked against an oracle in the test that uses terrain lookups only. Resting places are an exact list of 18 entries, 2 per dock, and the outcome counts must add up to the number of lanes. With the spur temporarily restored, the sweep failed on Palm Key, south dock at (22, 29) and (21, 29). After removing it, both are gone. The sweep takes about 7.5-10 s. The old lateral-offset corner test and the sweep got a 30 s timeout, because the old test took 9-12 s under machine load (load average 8), with the new step.ts and with the old one. Checks run: npm ci; npm run typecheck (pass); npm run test:unit (560 passed); npm run test:integration (38 passed); npm run build (pass); the full Playwright suite with the JSON reporter (6/6 passed, check-report OK); sail-and-dock with --repeat-each=5 (5/5 passed). Decisions: the operator addendum from design challenge attempt 5 (hull-overlap tiles, the column-25 test at (23, 27), the Chebyshev ring, stale sketch.ts references, the docs sentence) was adopted as binding.
open_assumptions: A lane ends once the ship is more than 6 tiles (Chebyshev) from the berth, because with a fixed heading each axis moves one way only. A lane still under way after 400 steps counts as a failure.
Removing the spur changes no validator result; I checked this with map:build.
packages/content/src/raw.d.ts (not owned) has a comment saying only the drift test uses ?raw. That is now slightly stale, and I left it unchanged.
I added a 30 s timeout to the existing lateral-offset corner test. I did not change its assertions.
